dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - APM - Throughput and Latency
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for PHP APM request volume, latency percentiles, Apdex, current-versus-previous behavior, and route-level latency. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: Throughput and latency
pages.description: Request volume and latency behavior for backend PHP transactions.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(duration) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago COMPARE WITH 24 hours ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 50, 95, 99) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT apdex(duration, t: 0.5) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(duration), percentile(duration, 95), percentile(duration, 99), count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT histogram(duration, width: 0.25, buckets: 20) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Initial Apdex target is 0.5 seconds for API responsiveness. Revisit after stable production baseline data is available.
